projectDescription: A web app for sharing MP3/MP4 audio files with friends through private group-based music libraries.
keyFeatures: MP3 and MP4 file uploads via Supabase Storage
Track library with title, artist, and upload metadata
Download tracks shared within a group
Real-time dashboard with recently uploaded tracks
publicApiSurface: GET /api/groups?user_id={id} — list groups for a user
POST /api/upload-file — upload an audio file to Supabase Storage
GET /api/download-content — download a stored audio file
POST /api/confirm-invite — confirm a group member invitation
uploadFileToSupabase(file) — server action to upload file
uploadMusic(fileMetadata, title, artist, groupId) — server action to record a track
getTracksForGroup(groupId) — fetch tracks for a group
getTracksFromUser(userId) — fetch tracks uploaded by a user
getTracksFromAllGroups(userId) — fetch all tracks from user's groups
searchTracks(query) — search tracks by title or artist
downloadMedia(url) — download a file from storage
getGroupMembers(groupId) — fetch members of a group
